B Glenmore Landing: base linework (CAD preview)

Lines only, one colour per layer; DXF layer names on the right. Frame 1.10 × 1.45 km, extended north to the Heritage Park entrance. EPSG:3776, local metres from the red cross (origin -6819.70, 5648879.79). Sources: City of Calgary Open Data (assessment parcels, street centrelines, buildings, hydrology, regulatory flood map, tree canopy 2022, Impervious Surface 2021, Tracks – Non-LRT); NRCan HRDEM 1 m DTM (2020 LiDAR). Parcels are assessment parcels, not survey lines. Road edges are the City's 2021 impervious-surface outlines. Canopy outlines under 10 m² dropped. Place labels checked against Esri imagery.

Ground: 1062.0–1103.6 m; contours from the 1 m DTM, lightly smoothed (σ 1.5 m).
